name: StatsDeck
description:
StatsDeck gives Claude context on your fantasy football leagues. By syncing your roster, current stats, and exact league scoring, it allows you and Claude to collaborate seamlessly on the best strategies to manage your team.

StatsDeck also brings NFL-wide data including usage, injuries, and matchups — plus its own models and rankings to supplement your decision-making. StatsDeck never supports betting, spreads, or Daily Fantasy Sports (DFS) content.

_published_faq.name: How do I add StatsDeck to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add StatsDeck to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.statsdeck.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the StatsDeck MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: StatsDeck lists 20 MCP tools, including connect_league, disconnect_league, draft_help, get_available_players, get_fantasy_matchup, get_injuries, get_kicker_stats, get_league_team, get_my_roster, get_player_stats, get_rankings, and get_schedule.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to StatsDeck?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to StatsDeck in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include Credits.fm, SceneF, HANKOOKILBO MCP, Ticketbox.vn, and drawnames.
StatsDeck requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
StatsDeck is developed by StatsDeck. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
